subject: Compact recap: 5-week engagement map & next steps (BrightHarbor)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@brightharbor.ai>, Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@brightharbor.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Compact recap: 5-week engagement map & next steps (BrightHarbor)

Hi Sanjay / Alicia —

Thanks again for the demo and the thoughtful questions today. Per our call I wanted to send a short, actionable recap and a proposed 5-week engagement map so your team can confirm resource availability and success criteria. I left the timeline intentionally compact to help BrightHarbor get to measurable results fast.

Summary of what we saw today
- Ingest + semantic search with Redwood embeddings: initial index built from 50k docs (preview)
- Latency target: 95th percentile < 120ms for single-query retrieval under baseline traffic
- Cost target: < $0.002/token (after batching & KV cache) for generation-heavy flows

Proposed success criteria (please confirm or edit)
1) Query relevance: top-3 precision >= 82% on your 100 holdout queries
2) Latency: 95p < 120ms for representative 90/10 traffic mix
3) Integration: working API contract + SDK example in your staging environment
4) Business metric: 10% reduction in average time-to-answer for analyst workflows by week 5

5-week engagement map (owners)
- Week 0 (prep): legal & procurement checklist, sandbox access, data prep (BrightHarbor data eng)
- Week 1: index build + baseline eval (Redwood: Marissa lead; BH: Data Eng)
- Week 2: prompt/format tuning and latency profiling (Redwood: Karthik + infra)
- Week 3: feature integration (SDK, end-to-end test cases)
- Week 4: acceptance evaluation against holdout queries, QA fixes
- Week 5: wrap, handoff, and executive summary (decision: go/no-go)

Immediate asks / next steps
- Alicia: confirm two BrightHarbor owners (data eng lead + product owner) and preferred kickoff week (we suggested Oct 19)
- Sanjay: confirm acceptance metrics above or list edits by EOD Wed
- Marissa / Stephanie (Redwood): I'll put together a short SOW and SOC2 summary; sharing in this thread.

Attachments: 5-week-engagement-outline.pdf (outline + milestone checklist)
Links: Sandbox access form: https://redwood.app/sandbox-request (fill once procurement greenlit)

If that looks good we can post a short SOW and aim to start the week of Oct 19 — otherwise share adjustments and I’ll update the plan.

Best,
Karthik
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
attachments: [5-week-engagement-outline.pdf]

From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@brightharbor.ai>

Subject: Re: Compact recap: 5-week engagement map & next steps (BrightHarbor)

Thanks Karthik — helpful and concise. A few quick items from our side:

1) Success criteria edits: change "top-3 precision >= 82%" to "top-3 precision >= 85%" if achievable; otherwise call it out as a stretch goal.
2) Procurement: we'll need a one-page SOC2 summary and our procurement team will want a 30-day trial addendum if possible.
3) Resources: Alicia will be the product lead; I will assign Suresh (data eng) as technical owner.

Kickoff week: Oct 19 works for us provided procurement gets the addendum by Oct 15. Would you be able to share a brief SOC2 summary and a simple trial addendum draft?

One more ask: can we include a brief runbook for handling PII in the index (masking/retention)? Not a blocker for kickoff but important to surface early.

– Sanjay
Director of Product
BrightHarbor Analytics

Appreciate the quick replies and the ownership assignments. Responding inline:

- Top-3 precision: we can treat 85% as a stretch goal. We'll baseline first and aim for >=82% as the committed metric; we'll call out the path to 85% in the SOW (data augmentation, relevance tuning).
- SOC2: attaching a short SOC2-summary.pdf (controls and what we share during a trial).
- Trial addendum: Marissa will draft a one-page addendum for a 30-day contractual trial and route to your procurement.
- PII runbook: Stephanie will draft a minimal runbook covering masking + retention + access controls for indexed content; expect that by Wed EOD.

Proposed start: Oct 19 (Week 0 prep this week) — if procurement requires longer, we can run a partial tech kickoff (indexing & sandbox access) ahead of signatures.

Next steps (owner tags)
- Marissa: SOW + 30-day addendum (deliver by Thu Oct 15)
- Stephanie: PII runbook (Wed Oct 14 EOD)
- Alicia / Suresh: confirm data slice for initial index (CSV export of 50k docs) and confirm staging credentials

Attachments: SOC2-summary.pdf

I’ll follow up with the SOW and send a calendar invite for Oct 19 tentative kickoff.
